state_colors_derivation.hover: interactive with HSL lightness -6% (same hue/saturation) for button hover feedback
state_colors_derivation.pressed: interactive with HSL lightness -12% (same hue/saturation) for button pressed feedback
state_colors_derivation.disabled: fixed neutral grey; intentionally not contrast-tested because WCAG 2.1 exempts disabled-control text/graphics from the contrast requirement
state_colors_derivation.selected_row: 12% interactive alpha-blended over panel, for QTableView row-selection fill (not a text color; ink text drawn on top retains full ink-on-page-class contrast)
state_colors_derivation.gridline: 12% ink alpha-blended over page, for low-contrast table/section separators (deliberately below body-text contrast; a divider, not text)
state_colors_derivation.focus_ring: a distinct, brighter blue (not the base interactive hex) so a focused primary button's own ring never blends into its own fill; rendered with a small page-colored offset from the control edge

contrast.methodology: WCAG 2.x relative luminance and contrast ratio: per-channel sRGB c'=c/255 linearized as c/12.92 when c'<=0.03928 else ((c'+0.055)/1.055)^2.4; L=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B; ratio=(L_lighter+0.05)/(L_darker+0.05). Computed against both background tokens (page #F6F4EF and panel #FFFFFF); page yields the lower (binding) ratio for every foreground below since it is slightly darker than panel.

note: This file is the machine-authoritative token source for WI-005 (主题 token、QSS、资源和高 DPI); UI_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md documents the same values in prose and must stay numerically in sync with this file and with config.json.ui_tokens (font_points/spacing_dip/control heights/content width/window minimum).
